title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode14 Who am "I"?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mom, Dad, look! I got full marks on my test!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
That's great, Mafuyu.
Looks like all that hard work paid off.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I hear you've been studying hard every day.
I'm proud of you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehehe! Thanks!
I'll work even harder to make sure I do good on the next one too!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Welcome back, Mafuyu. Dinner's ready, so come sit down.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wow, it looks delicious! Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: What does your homework look like today, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've got some math and an essay to write about what I want to be in the future.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh? And what is it you'd like to be in the future?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to become a nurse so I can help people who are sick.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is that so...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But if you really want to help those who are sick, there are even better jobs than that, you know.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Being a nurse is wonderful, but if you're going to get into medicine, why not become a doctor instead?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
That's right. You'd make a great doctor.
And you're more than capable of handling the amount of study required.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If you become a doctor, you can even take care of us when we're old and gray. Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Don't worry about tuition, either.
You just focus on getting into the best school you can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be supporting you as well, so good luck!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...okay...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thanks for always thinking about me, Mom, Dad. I'll do my best.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: If Mom and Dad are both going to support me, maybe this is the better option.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: This...will make them happy, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, Mafuyu. Are you free tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: A bunch of us from class are planning on going to that new arcade. You wanna come?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, sure. I'd—

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line:
Of course she doesn't want to go!
She's the top student in our grade!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: She's too busy with club and all those tournaments, not to mention studying. She never has time to go have any fun.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, I guess you're right. Sorry for bothering you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. Maybe next time.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ms. Asahina, I read your essay.
So you'd like to be a doctor?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That's a wonderful goal. I think you'll make a great doctor.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll be sure to study harder.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Good luck.
Make sure to let me know if there's anything you need help with.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
What? You're going to be a doctor!
That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line:
That's perfect for you!
You're always so nice, looking out for everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's not like I even know if I'll be able to yet.
I appreciate the vote of confidence, though.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Everyone's so excited for me.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If they're happy for me, that must mean this is the right decision.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If Mom, Dad, my classmates, and even my teachers are happy, then I suppose this is right...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu, I bought you some cake since you've been studying so hard lately. The shop is really popular, so I'm sure it's delicious.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thanks, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe I should take a break.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(This cake doesn't taste like much to me.
Mom said it was good, though, so it must be.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But it's not just the cake.
Everything tastes a little bland lately, even restaurant food and Mom's cooking.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wonder if I'm just overthinking this. Maybe I should do something I like to get my mind off things for a while.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: ...What things DO I like?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Haha. How strange. I must just be tired from studying so much.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I still need to listen to that song everyone was telling me about yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: They said it's really bright and cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: What exactly is a cheerful song?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: What was it I liked? What did I want to do again?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Where...is the real me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I searched and I searched. I made song after song.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I still couldn't find it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's alright to give up now, right Miku?
